pages.title: Prism Drive
pages.text: Provides $(l)4 slots$() for storage prisms. Capacity, type limit and speed are shown on each prism's tooltip. Connect the drive to the network.

pages.title: Item Terminal
pages.text: Displays the combined contents of all network prisms. Left-click to take a stack; items from the player inventory can be inserted into the network.

pages.title: Storage Link
pages.text: Place an external inventory behind the block. It provides five filters, whitelist/blacklist modes and one-way automatic transfer once per second.
